method: Pesquisa histórica preservada; a ampliação 4.8 usa fontes públicas por pesquisa web sem APIs pagas. Ver observações e limites de cada fonte.

sources.title: SCI-Arc · Split Diopter
sources.lesson: Foco simultâneo em planos próximos e distantes.

sources.title: IOP · The Physics and Art of Photography
sources.lesson: Óptica, fotogramas, sombras e fotografia estenopeica; resumo e índice públicos, não livro integral.

sources.title: Springer · Schlieren and Shadowgraph Techniques
sources.lesson: Visualização de variações ópticas em meios transparentes; resumo público.

sources.title: The Graphic Design School · Suprematism
sources.lesson: Composição geométrica não representativa.

sources.title: Whatever Together · Surface Treatment
sources.lesson: Imagem lenticular muda com o ponto de observação.

sources.title: The Met · Materials and Techniques
sources.lesson: Materiais e processos determinam marcas visuais; referência metodológica, não fonte específica de cada técnica.

sources.title: UNESCO · Ebru
sources.lesson: Pigmentos flutuantes e transferência para papel; respeitar contexto cultural.

sources.title: Taxonomy of Uncertainty Visualization Methods
sources.lesson: Separar representação, incerteza, legibilidade e carga visual.

sources.title: RMCAD · Experimental Animation
sources.lesson: Animação experimental como investigação de meio e processo.

sources.title: Optical Arts · T-Tension
sources.lesson: Tensão, suspensão e liberação conduzem ação física. Não copiar escultura ou campanha.

sources.title: Sachiko Kodama · Morpho Towers
sources.lesson: Resposta de ferrofluido a campos magnéticos; estudar mecanismo, não reproduzir obra.

sources.title: Builders Club · Beats 360
sources.lesson: Atributos e ações do produto orientam motivos visuais. Texto do caso consultado; reprodução do vídeo não verificada.

sources.title: Adobe · Architectural Photography
sources.lesson: Enquadramento, luz e documentação de espaços.

sources.title: Pixpro · Photogrammetry Limitations
sources.lesson: Cobertura, cena estável, reflexos e falhas de reconstrução.

sources.title: Google Maps · Isochrones Best Practices
sources.lesson: Resolução, rede viária e limites de áreas alcançáveis; conferir disponibilidade do serviço.

sources.title: Figma · Keyboard Controls
sources.lesson: Ações e limitações reais de teclado, navegação e acessibilidade.

sources.title: Google Fonts · Introducing Variable Fonts
sources.lesson: Eixos reais de peso, largura e outras variações; conferir eixos disponíveis na fonte.

sources.title: Designboom · Kinetic Storefront
sources.lesson: Painéis físicos articulados revelam sequência por rotação.

sources.title: Jim Henson's Creature Shop · Earth to Ned
sources.lesson: Atuação de personagens exige sistema de manipulação, rastreamento e revisão; não copiar personagens.

sources.title: Nexus Studios · Marc & Emma
sources.lesson: Materialidade artesanal em personagens e ambientes; personagens deste atlas são originais.

sources.title: AAD · Questions before cosmetic treatment
sources.lesson: Dúvidas sobre objetivos, opções, riscos, recuperação, custo e qualificação; orientação dos EUA, não substitui regras profissionais brasileiras.

sources.title: UCLA Dentistry · Desensitization resources
sources.lesson: Familiarização com ambiente, cadeira e sons odontológicos. Texto consultado; vídeos não considerados assistidos.

sources.title: Revisão sobre teach-back em educação de pacientes
sources.lesson: Verificar entendimento por reformulação, com limites de evidência; não confundir comunicação educativa com diagnóstico.

sources.title: Mercado Livre · Clips de produtos
sources.lesson: Vídeos vinculados ao item para mostrar funções e responder dúvidas; verificar regras atuais do canal antes da exportação.

sources.title: Amazon · Product videos
sources.lesson: Demonstração, setup, troubleshooting e compreensão sem som. Regras variam por modalidade e região; não adotar números promocionais como promessa.

sources.title: Baymard · In-scale product images
sources.lesson: Referências de escala ajudam a avaliar dimensões; vídeo complementa e não substitui imagens úteis do produto.

sources.title: Baymard · Embedding product videos
sources.lesson: Vídeos precisam ser encontráveis junto às imagens, com miniatura clara; pesquisa contextual, não garantia de conversão.

sources.title: Teachable · Student success and course design
sources.lesson: Orientar início, próxima ação, prática, feedback e apoio. Alegações promocionais da plataforma não foram convertidas em garantias.

sources.title: Hotmart · Engajamento no curso online
sources.lesson: Necessidade de motivação, dinâmica de aula e trocas em comunidade; aplicar ao conteúdo real do produtor.

sources.title: Vanderbilt · Effective Educational Videos
sources.lesson: Sinalização, segmentação, carga cognitiva e aprendizagem ativa; evitar efeitos e música que disputem atenção com o ensino.

sources.title: Thinkific · Online course launch checklist
sources.lesson: Distinguir lançamento, prévia, webinar, oferta, acesso inicial e comunicação pós-compra; texto consultado, sem adotar promessas de conversão.

sources.title: Thinkific · Marketing an online course
sources.lesson: Promo, mini-curso, webinar, conteúdo gratuito e prova de processo são usos diferentes; uma única estética não atende a todos.

sources.title: Teachable · Building a membership site
sources.lesson: Boas-vindas, início claro, encontros, materiais e relevância do conteúdo; não converter estimativas promocionais de receita em promessa.

sources.title: Hotmart · Tipos de infoprodutos
sources.lesson: Cursos, ebooks, videoaulas, webinars e mentorias pedem demonstrações e recursos próprios; não restringir o nicho a sala de aula.

sources.title: Wistia · Lighting for video
sources.lesson: Luz de chave, preenchimento, separação e ambiente ajudam a produzir fala e demonstração com aparência fotográfica; texto consultado, vídeo não assistido.

sources.title: Mitch Paone · Time Is the Material
sources.lesson: Comportamento, ritmo e proporção como sistema de identidade; texto consultado.

sources.title: BUCK · Citrix
sources.lesson: Articulação entre filmagem representacional, CG abstrato, material, iluminação e composição; estudo textual, vídeo incorporado não assistido.

sources.title: BUCK · Oura: Ring True to You
sources.lesson: Campanha com cenas de pessoas, 3D e mundos de cor ligados ao conceito; sem reutilizar imagens ou promessas comerciais.

sources.title: BUCK · Microsoft Surface Pro
sources.lesson: Integração de filmagem, cenário, composição e cor; consulta ao texto e créditos, não playback do filme.

sources.title: V&A · An A to Z of photographic processes
sources.lesson: Óptica e processos históricos como direção de aparência; não copiar fotografias do acervo.

sources.title: Saint Louis Art Museum · Glossary of Printmaking and Photographic Techniques
sources.lesson: O processo e a matriz determinam a marca visual; usar desenhos e materiais próprios.

sources.title: Trollbäck+Company · Motion Conference
sources.lesson: Experimentação física, fabricação e efeitos em câmera articulam campanhas táteis; texto do caso consultado, sem reutilizar ativos ou afirmar playback.

sources.title: Magic Pulpo · MyBerlitz Speaking Tutor
sources.lesson: Capturas do produto e ações de aprendizagem podem organizar a explicação; funções precisam ser verificadas no sistema real.

sources.title: Shakuro · Channel D
sources.lesson: Educação por vídeo na experiência do paciente, com linguagem clara; resultados comerciais do caso não são evidência clínica.

sources.title: Observable · Bullet graph
sources.lesson: Referência textual de codificação gráfica; os dados da amostra são fictícios e cada produção exige escalas, unidades e fonte.

sources.title: Powers of Ten — Eames Office
sources.verifiedRecognition: C.I.N.E. 1978 Golden Eagle listed by Eames Office; preservation in US National Film Registry also stated, which is recognition rather than an award.
sources.principle: Changing scale connects a human situation to a larger or smaller explanatory system.
sources.adaptation: Motivated scale journeys for energy, logistics, materials and technical services; generated microscopic views are identified models, never real microscopy.
sources.lesson: Changing scale connects a human situation to a larger or smaller explanatory system.

sources.title: Apple Welcome Home — D&AD archive
sources.verifiedRecognition: D&AD 2018; archive lists Yellow, Graphite and Wood Pencils.
sources.principle: Physical space and visual effects respond to human action.
sources.adaptation: Purposeful transitions between object, gesture and environment; preserve the customer's actual location and available views.
sources.lesson: Physical space and visual effects respond to human action.

sources.title: Channel 4 Street Summer — D&AD archive
sources.verifiedRecognition: D&AD 2012; Yellow and Wood Pencils listed.
sources.principle: Zooming and panning connect performers and locations while maintaining a coherent visual world.
sources.adaptation: Commercial walkthroughs and changes of point of view that reveal a useful relationship.
sources.lesson: Zooming and panning connect performers and locations while maintaining a coherent visual world.

sources.title: The Truth Is Worth It: Rigor — The One Show
sources.verifiedRecognition: 2019 One Show Film Gold Pencil; annual ID OS_FI19002G.
sources.principle: A short film can organize evidence into an understandable narrative.
sources.adaptation: Evidence-led explanations of documents, inspection and business processes; no copied copy or factual claims.
sources.lesson: A short film can organize evidence into an understandable narrative.

sources.title: Air Max Day 16 — Motion Awards
sources.principle: Kinetic physical metaphors can reveal product design and process.
sources.adaptation: Objects assemble, separate and reconnect to explain a product or service; literal physical claims still require sources.
sources.lesson: Kinetic physical metaphors can reveal product design and process.

sources.title: How I Make My Maps — Johnny Harris
sources.observation: Indexed official-channel metadata; no full-playback claim or award claim for this particular video.
sources.principle: Use maps and visual explanations as part of the reasoning.
sources.lesson: Use maps and visual explanations as part of the reasoning.

sources.title: A Guided Tour of iPhone 16 and iPhone 16 Pro — Apple
sources.observation: Indexed official-channel metadata; no full-playback claim or award claim.
sources.principle: Presenter-led product demonstration in recognizable everyday situations.
sources.lesson: Presenter-led product demonstration in recognizable everyday situations.

sources.title: Rotate the Look — 31 Agency case study
sources.observation: Agency case study of a presenter-led social Reel, product details, edit, color and sound; not an award claim.
sources.principle: A human invitation can lead to a product film with motivated detail shots.
sources.lesson: A human invitation can lead to a product film with motivated detail shots.

sources.title: The Perfume Sommelier — Birkholz
sources.observation: Brand page describes perfume education and links the sommelier's TikTok; no full social-video viewing claim.
sources.principle: Demonstrate real objects and explain one aspect of a product in accessible language.
sources.lesson: Demonstrate real objects and explain one aspect of a product in accessible language.

sources.title: MasterNose — Nose Paris
sources.observation: Official educational series description, not an award claim.
sources.principle: Practical product education through one focused question and demonstrable materials.
sources.lesson: Practical product education through one focused question and demonstrable materials.

sources.title: BUCK — work portfolio
sources.observation: Portfolio descriptions for branding, product, live action, motion and systems; no blanket award claim.
sources.principle: A coherent design system can support different narrative and motion expressions.
sources.lesson: A coherent design system can support different narrative and motion expressions.

sources.title: Minha Casa, Minha Vida — Ministério das Cidades
sources.observation: Official programme page confirms the current name Minha Casa, Minha Vida; page updated 28 October 2026. Eligibility, rates and conditions must be checked for the actual production.
sources.principle: Explain the buying process with current sources; never infer approval, subsidy or payment from a fictional apartment.
sources.lesson: Explain the buying process with current sources; never infer approval, subsidy or payment from a fictional apartment.

sources.title: Tiago Cadore — Diário do Comércio, 27 February 2025
sources.observation: Article reports 2.8 million views for a routine video and 520 thousand for a musical luxury-property presentation, at publication. Reported historical counts, not independently verified current platform engagement or sales.
sources.principle: A presenter with personality can make the property memorable; original scripts and licensed sound only.
sources.lesson: A presenter with personality can make the property memorable; original scripts and licensed sound only.

sources.title: Ricardo Martins — Exame
sources.observation: Article describes a 30-second apartment video with a car in the living room; six million weekly views refers to reported aggregate reach, not a verified individual-post ranking.
sources.principle: A concrete unusual property detail can open a useful explanation; no invented amenities.
sources.lesson: A concrete unusual property detail can open a useful explanation; no invented amenities.

sources.title: Verônica Kreitchmann — Jornal do Comércio
sources.observation: Public report of tours and a recognizable presenter persona; no comparable per-post ranking or retention data.
sources.principle: A guided visit connects place, detail and everyday use.
sources.lesson: A guided visit connects place, detail and everyday use.

sources.title: Enes Yilmazer — Bel Air home tour
sources.observation: Public indexed metadata snapshot: 2,554,346 views and 41,000 likes, published 2 March 2020. Snapshot is not a current live count. Complete playback was unavailable; no shot-by-shot analysis claimed.
sources.principle: Relate architectural detail to a guided spatial journey, using authorized coverage.
sources.lesson: Relate architectural detail to a guided spatial journey, using authorized coverage.

sources.title: Dental implants explained — European Federation of Periodontology
sources.observation: Primary patient-education source; components, assessment and restoration depend on individual clinical conditions.
sources.principle: Use a model to distinguish implant support from the restoration, without diagnosing a viewer.
sources.lesson: Use a model to distinguish implant support from the restoration, without diagnosing a viewer.

sources.title: Dental implants FAQs — European Federation of Periodontology
sources.observation: Primary patient-education source on components, integration and individual care. No universal healing deadline is transferred into the catalogue.
sources.principle: Explain biological integration and maintenance in accessible language.
sources.lesson: Explain biological integration and maintenance in accessible language.

sources.title: How do dental implants work? — AAOMS MyOMS
sources.observation: Professional-association patient guide. Suitability and loading are clinical decisions, not a universal sequence or promise.
sources.principle: Separate educational stages from personal indication and timing.
sources.lesson: Separate educational stages from personal indication and timing.

sources.title: Immediate procedure — Straumann patient guide
sources.observation: Manufacturer patient guide, not independent comparative evidence; immediate options depend on assessment and conditions.
sources.principle: Distinguish placement, provisional restoration and loading without promising immediate treatment.
sources.lesson: Distinguish placement, provisional restoration and loading without promising immediate treatment.

sources.title: Divulgação em vídeos — Conselho Federal de Odontologia
sources.observation: Professional-regulator educational guidance; check current applicable rules for the real publication. No patient records, fake credentials or clinical-result claims are included.
sources.principle: Prefer informative models and professional review over sensational procedure imagery.
sources.lesson: Prefer informative models and professional review over sensational procedure imagery.

sources.title: Dental Implant Procedure — indexed YouTube reference
sources.observation: Indexed snapshot: 21,043,692 views and 321,000 likes; publication 22 June 2026. Only public indexed title/description/metrics, no full playback. Popularity is not clinical-quality evidence.
sources.principle: A model can decompose components; clinical claims require primary professional sources.
sources.lesson: A model can decompose components; clinical claims require primary professional sources.

sources.title: Dental implant process in 4K — indexed YouTube reference
sources.observation: Indexed snapshot: 40,834,373 views and 96,000 likes; publication 22 March 2022. No complete playback or engagement-ranking claim.
sources.principle: Show structural relationships clearly, without reproducing surgical instructions.
sources.lesson: Show structural relationships clearly, without reproducing surgical instructions.

sources.title: INGAGE — equipe e ambiente de trabalho
sources.observation: Public official careers page and its workplace photograph (IMG_3715.jpg), inspected privately. Reference for ordinary dual-monitor workstations, daylight and personal desk items, not a copied person or office.
sources.principle: Use practical contemporary workwear, real desk proportions, cables, notebooks and varied adult professionals.
sources.lesson: Use practical contemporary workwear, real desk proportions, cables, notebooks and varied adult professionals.

sources.title: GhFly — ambiente da agência, Gazeta do Povo
sources.observation: Public press-photo search result describes a team in an open office with dual monitors, everyday objects and glass partitions. Original full photo retrieval failed; no full-photo viewing claim.
sources.principle: Anchor the environment in ordinary team operations rather than a futuristic control room.
sources.lesson: Anchor the environment in ordinary team operations rather than a futuristic control room.

sources.title: Shopify — visão geral das Análises
sources.observation: Official product guidance consulted for metrics, time filters, period comparisons and report drill-down. Mock interfaces in new styles are illustrative, not live Shopify accounts.
sources.principle: Build one question at a time; keep metric definition, denominator, period and source coherent.
sources.lesson: Build one question at a time; keep metric definition, denominator, period and source coherent.

sources.title: Google Analytics — attribution and conversion reporting
sources.observation: Official attribution guide consulted; platform settings and report availability can change. No account was accessed and no campaign was run.
sources.principle: Connect events and attribution windows without presenting attributed revenue as causal lift or profit.
sources.lesson: Connect events and attribution windows without presenting attributed revenue as causal lift or profit.

sources.title: Google Ads — comparação de tipos de Lift
sources.observation: Official measurement guidance; causal conclusions require appropriate design, eligibility and evidence. Not a performance promise.
sources.principle: Separate observation, attribution, hypothesis and incremental-effect evidence.
sources.lesson: Separate observation, attribution, hypothesis and incremental-effect evidence.

sources.title: NIST — Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
sources.observation: NIST AI 600-1; primary guidance on evaluation, provenance, ongoing review and oversight. Not certification of a fictional business solution.
sources.principle: Make document origins, human review, exceptions, test criteria and limitations visible in business explanations.
sources.lesson: Make document origins, human review, exceptions, test criteria and limitations visible in business explanations.

sources.title: Google Ads — classificação do anúncio e leilão
sources.observation: Official definition consulted. Bid, ad/landing-page quality, thresholds, competition, search context and expected asset impact can matter. No fixed weight ranking or universal formula is inferred.
sources.principle: A partial educational model can relate selected criteria without inventing their relative weights or guaranteeing delivery/sales.
sources.lesson: A partial educational model can relate selected criteria without inventing their relative weights or guaranteeing delivery/sales.

sources.title: CRCSP/CRCRS — técnicas e práticas de gestão de custos
sources.observation: Public professional education material distinguishes contribution after variable costs from the amount remaining after fixed costs. A business video still needs the actual cost definitions and responsible review.
sources.principle: Show contribution margin and fixed-cost/result stages separately; do not label contribution as net profit.
sources.lesson: Show contribution margin and fixed-cost/result stages separately; do not label contribution as net profit.

previousMethod: Pesquisa textual com Firecrawl e Exa; direções autorais informadas por princípios documentados. Fontes são referências de técnica e método, não autoria das combinações propostas nem imagens reutilizadas.
